name: Real public incidents - provisional v1
scope: Public production network and software-service incident reports; not private Ericsson data or a representative telecom sample.
evidence_basis: Brief original paraphrases of operator-reported diagnostic facts. Retrospective reconstruction, not timestamped live telemetry. The recovery action is kept outside evidence.
label_status: Provisional coarse action mappings by the project assistant; pending independent expert review. A mapped action can be only one component of recovery.
risk_status: Project-assigned impact judgment, not the source operator's severity score.
license_note: Source articles retain their original rights. This collection contains short paraphrases and attribution, not full articles. No license for the original articles is asserted.

excluded_candidates.reason: Recovery disabled a router; the four-action taxonomy lacks traffic isolation.
Regional traffic rerouting is not one of the supported actions.
Immediate recovery was failover, not the later capacity improvement.
Recovery involved traffic rerouting and restoration of removed resources.
Rate-limit and job-admission tuning do not unambiguously mean adding capacity.
